d: Watch the match highlights and all goals from Jordan vs Argentina in Group J of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Dallas Stadium in Dallas, Texas. After Giovani Lo Celso opened the scoring on a 19th-minute free kick and Lautaro Martínez doubled the lead from the penalty spot in the 31st minute, substitute Mousa Al-Tamari pulled one back for Jordan in the 55th minute before Lionel Messi came off the bench to curl home an 80th-minute free kick, sealing a 3-1 win that sent Argentina into the Round of 32 with a perfect group-stage record.
